title: Knowledge graph-constrained large language model agent for automated finite element modeling of girder bridges: research materials
description: BridgeFE-Bench (33 girder-bridge FE modeling problems with decision-level reference answers), the executable bridge knowledge graph and constraints, agent prompts and tool definitions, run records and session files, analysis and replay scripts, and verification evidence for the associated manuscript. Code is licensed under MIT and data/documentation under CC BY 4.0; design-code provision excerpts and content derived from standard drawings are excluded (see LICENSES.md).
